# SmartCalcLab

> Free multilingual online multi-calculators for personal finance, mortgage estimating, vehicle financing, currency conversions, body mass index (BMI), percentages, and net salary.

SmartCalcLab (https://smartcalclab.com) is a high-speed, client-side calculator suite designed for accuracy, sub-200ms speed, and privacy. All calculations run locally in the browser with zero user tracking or data retention.

## Available Calculators

- [Annual to Gross & Net Salary Calculator](https://smartcalclab.com/salary): Converts hourly, monthly, or annual wages to gross and net take-home pay with regional tax presets (US FICA, UK PAYE, Spain IRPF, Canada CPP/EI, India New Regime) and standard 2,080 working-hour benchmarks.
- [Mortgage Cost Estimator & Loan Calculator](https://smartcalclab.com/loan): Calculates monthly mortgage payments (PITI), total interest, down payments, and full yearly amortization schedules.
- [Auto Loan & Car Payment Calculator](https://smartcalclab.com/autoloan): Estimates monthly car loan payments, trade-in value, sales tax, APR interest rates, and loan terms from 24 to 84 months.
- [Body Mass Index (BMI) Calculator](https://smartcalclab.com/bmi): Computes BMI in metric (kg/cm) and imperial (lbs/ft) units with WHO weight category charts and healthy weight ranges.
- [Compound Interest & Wealth Simulator](https://smartcalclab.com/compound): Forecasts exponential investment growth, annual returns, and regular monthly contributions.
- [Live Currency Converter](https://smartcalclab.com/currency): Real-time foreign exchange rates for USD, EUR, GBP, MXN, SAR, AED, INR, and global fiat currencies.
- [Percentage & Discount Calculator](https://smartcalclab.com/percentage): Solves percentage increase/decrease, retail shopping discounts, and local sales tax.

## Supported Languages

SmartCalcLab supports 7 global languages with self-referencing canonical URLs and hreflang annotations:
- English: https://smartcalclab.com/?lang=en
- Spanish: https://smartcalclab.com/?lang=es
- Portuguese: https://smartcalclab.com/?lang=pt
- French: https://smartcalclab.com/?lang=fr
- German: https://smartcalclab.com/?lang=de
- Arabic: https://smartcalclab.com/?lang=ar
- Hindi: https://smartcalclab.com/?lang=hi
